dates: d. 25 Oct 1893 (printed p. 43: «въ воскресенье, 25-го октября 1893 года, онъ скончался»)
evidence_verbatim: Мои воспоминанія о П. И. Чайковскомъ
evidence_english: Bessel's memoir of Tchaikovsky; it ends on his last days and death.
author: В. Бессель (signed С.-Петербургъ, Апрѣль 1897 года)
notes: A personal memoir, not a memorial article: no anniversary invoked. Almost entirely about Bessel's publishing dealings with him and the staging of «Опричникъ»; no ballet is named anywhere in the 25 pages, so the tier rests only on Tchaikovsky being a ballet composer. Read once, 2026-10-12.

dates: b. 1830, Moscow («родилась въ 1830 году въ Москвѣ»); no death date printed
evidence_english: Two forgotten Russian dancers: section I, on Nadezhda Bogdanova.
author: М. В. Карнѣевъ
notes: Historical article, subtitle «(По поводу успѣха русскаго балета за границей)»; it marks no anniversary. Ends with her leaving for abroad in 1861-62 when the Directorate did not renew her contract. Her father К. Ѳ. Богдановъ (Moscow dancer, school dance teacher, régisseur) retired on pension in 1846 (p. 120). Read once, 2026-10-12.
